<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/forwards/offers/{boxId}/fill"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Take the other side of an offer: this wallet adds its margin plus 7.5 LIT and the position's ERG, and a position holding both sides is created. Refused when the fill would not be accepted in the next block. No body.
